title: College running back MicahJo Barnett dies after medical emergency on sideline

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: College running back MicahJo Barnett dies after medical emergency on sideline
sources.description: MicahJo Barnett, a junior running back at William Jewell College in Missouri, died Saturday after experiencing a medical emergency on the sideline during a game, via the Associated Press.
